#UBSAKC #WeMoveTheKids #NeerajChopraFoundation #NeerajChopra #AthleticsKidsCup".

98K likes, 488 comments - neeraj____chopra on September 20, 2026: "अपणी बोली अर कल्चर का सिनेमा देखकै बहोत रिफ्रैश फील करू हूँ, तो सोच्या इतणे साल का यो सफ़र दो-चार शब्दां म्ह बयां करूं। 

AI तै सीरीज़ बणी “दादा छोटूराम” अर 40+ अवॉर्डस जीतण आळी फ़िल्म “सॉंकळ”  गवाह है के आण आळे टैम म्ह बहोत कुछ मज़ेदार होण आळा है हरियाणवी सिनेमा जगत म्ह। तब तक आप भी देखो, ये फ़िल्में और भी बेहतरीन सीरीज़; सिर्फ STAGE ऐप पै। ✨🔥🚀".

22K likes, 170 comments - neeraj____chopra on August 7, 2026: "Every child deserves an opportunity to discover and showcase their talent.

After two seasons as Ambassador, I’m excited to begin a new chapter as Co-Owner of @ubsathleticskidscup. I look forward to sharing my experiences with children, teachers and schools, and inspiring more youngsters to embrace sport.

The more children play, the greater the chance of creating future champions. 🇮🇳

It’s only fitting that I begin this new chapter on National Javelin Day, five years after an unforgettable moment that changed my life. Here’s to creating many more opportunities for the next generation. 🙏

#UBSAthleticsKidsCup #WeMoveTheKids".
